review.limitations: The patch only demonstrates support for one named legacy identifier. No wider compatibility, recovery, or migration handling is shown. The tier remains bounded by what is implemented rather than potential reach.
review.reason: This chunk adds a substantive, bounded capability: it enables the generic HogFunction API to create and list destinations tied specifically to a known legacy internal event, while preserving existing managed-alert exclusions. This changes observable behavior in the CDP backend and its tests, supporting correct operation for this use case. It does not show broader systemic risk reduction across components, nor claims of adoption or incident avoidance.
review.posthog_relevance: Relevant to PostHog’s warehouse-source and destination configuration workflows; allows users who rely on an older insight-alert-based destination pattern to continue creating those configurations through the standard HogFunction interface.
review.uncertainty: Only three hunks are provided; without seeing other related hunks, we cannot assess whether additional compatibility or cleanup work exists elsewhere. Metadata dependency is false; no external dependencies are invoked. Grouping issue is false; all hunks consistently implement the same exclusion and inclusion behavior around LEGACY_INSIGHT_ALERT_EVENT.
